## Beta 1

This prerelease is intended for testing before the stable 1.17.0 release.
Enable beta versions for this integration in HACS to install it.

## New: Devices update without a restart

Devices added to or removed from free@home now appear in and disappear from
Home Assistant automatically, without reloading the integration or restarting
Home Assistant.

- **Added devices** are created as soon as the SysAP reports them. Unless
  **Include channels NOT on the free@home floorplan?** is enabled, a device
  appears once one of its channels is placed on the floorplan.
- **Removed devices** are removed from Home Assistant together with their
  entities.
- **Unresponsive devices** have their entities marked unavailable, and they
  recover automatically when the device responds again.

This also applies to virtual devices: create one, place it on the floorplan,
and it shows up in Home Assistant right away.

Templates that read **Parameters** sensor attributes should handle missing
attributes, because attributes are absent while a device is unavailable.

[Documentation and template examples](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass#device-changes)

## New: Easier virtual-device creation

The **ABB-free@home: Virtual device** action now offers a device-type
dropdown, lifetime presets, and a System Access Point selector for installations
with multiple systems. Switches and an unlimited lifetime are selected by default,
and energy meters have a default profile with advanced overrides.

Enable **Include virtual devices?** in the integration options and place the
created device on the free@home floorplan. Linking it to a real Home Assistant
entity still requires automations. A lifetime of `0` marks the virtual device
offline; it does not delete it.

[Virtual-device setup and automation guidance](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass/wiki/Virtual-Devices)

## New: Optional repair alerts for unresponsive devices

Enable **Create repair issues for unresponsive devices?** to see a warning under
**Settings > Repairs** when a device stays unresponsive for five minutes.
Warnings clear automatically when the device recovers or is removed.

The option is disabled by default and can be changed through **Reconfigure** on
the integration. Warnings include guidance for checking battery, power or
connection issues, and expired virtual-device lifetimes.

[Repair-issue setup and behavior](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass#repair-issues-for-unresponsive-devices)

## New: Channel sub-devices grouped under their physical device

With **Create Sub-Devices for each independent channel?** enabled, Home Assistant
2026.9 and later groups channel sub-devices as children of their physical device.
Existing sub-devices are converted in place, keeping their device IDs, assigned
areas, labels, and user-defined names. Existing entity unique IDs are unchanged.
Older Home Assistant versions keep the previous behavior.

Removing or disabling a physical device also removes or disables its children.
Targeting the physical device in an action includes its children's entities.

**Downgrade warning:** on Home Assistant 2026.9 and later, downgrading to an
integration version without child-device support can prevent converted
sub-device entities from loading. Delete the child devices or turn off
**Create Sub-Devices for each independent channel?** if you need to downgrade.

[Sub-device configuration](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass#configuration)

## Fixed: Spurious events after WebSocket reconnects

The included `local-abbfreeathome` 3.12.0 update filters replayed datapoints after
WebSocket reconnects, preventing spurious events during slow SysAP reboots.
